changers.name: Nikko Forex
changers.loc: Station 2 / D'Mall area, a little off the main road down a side lane; sign is small and easy to miss. Of two previously known branches, one reported closed / moved.
changers.rate: trvlogue 2026 comparison (single traveler): best USD rate of all places compared, ahead of Golden Forex and D'Mall changers. No exact figure available.
changers.tips: Confirm which branch is operating before walking there; Korean blogger reported a wasted trip to a closed branch.
changers.kr: 한국 블로그에서 '환율 좋다고 유명한 곳'으로 가장 많이 언급. 두 지점 중 하나는 폐업/이전했다는 후기 있음.

changers.name: Golden Forex
changers.loc: White Beach (beach path) side, near Station 2
changers.rate: trvlogue 2026: slightly better than D'Mall changers, below Nikko Forex. No figure.
changers.kr: 한국어 블로그에서 Queen's와 함께 디몰/화이트비치 근처 환전소로 언급.

changers.name: Salamat Boracay (Korean-run tour agency, also exchanges)
changers.loc: 2nd floor of a building near D'Mall (Korean blog; exact address not verified)
changers.rate: Korean travel reviews (nate, undated): gives at least ~0.1 PHP better than street rate. Unverified.
changers.kr: 후기 2편에서 '일반 거리 환전 비율보다 0.1이라도 높게' 환전해 준다고 칭찬. 투어 예약과 함께 이용.

changers.name: Henann Garden Resort front desk
changers.rate: Mentioned as an option by trvlogue 2026; Korean blogs say hotel rates are lower than outside but not by much.
changers.tips: Good for a small first amount on arrival night.
changers.kr: 숙소 환전은 환율이 낮지만 큰 차이는 아니라 편하게 이용하는 것도 방법이라는 의견.

fruitSeason: Late November: mango is off-peak (peak Mar-Jun) but available year-round, possibly pricier. Lanzones commonly listed Aug-Dec, so likely still around. Mangosteen listed Jun/Aug-Nov by some sources, so tail end/uncertain. Rambutan peak Aug-Oct, so probably finished or scarce. Sources disagree.

quarantine.fresh_mango: PROHIBITED for travelers to carry in. Korea's Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency (농림축산검역본부) lists fresh fruits incl. mango as banned carry-on items. Philippine mango import is only allowed via designated commercial export orchards/packhouses, not personal luggage. Undeclared: fine up to KRW 10 million (reported for banned items). Must declare any agricultural item on arrival.
quarantine.other_fresh_fruit: Also banned (mangosteen, rambutan etc. are fresh fruit).
quarantine.dried_mango: Commercially processed, sealed dried mango (e.g. 7D) is widely bought by Korean travelers and a blog says it passes; however no official QIA statement was found. Hankyung (2025) quoting QIA: dried fruit containing seeds may be banned for some items. Dried mango slices have no seeds -- likely OK but declare if unsure.
quarantine.recommendation: Eat fresh fruit in Boracay; bring only sealed commercial dried mango; if in doubt, declare at the plant quarantine desk on arrival (Incheon).

fruitTips: Ask per-kg price first; some stalls price per piece/tray.
Korean blogs: cheaper than D'Mall for fruit; choose mangoes with unbruised skin and fresh stem, ask vendor to cut them for eating at hotel. Bargain politely; ask per-kg price before weighing.
Station 1 is a 15-20 min walk north from Henann Garden.
mangoPrice: D'Mall 과일가게 망고 1kg ₱150–200 (한국 여행사 블로그, 날짜 미상)
priceGuideNote: boracay.delivery 메뉴 3939개 + 직접 조사 가격 (2026-11-23 수집) 기준. 가운데 50%(하위 25%~상위 25% 제외)를 ‘적정’, 상위 10% 이상을 ‘비싼 편’으로 표시했어요. 배달 앱 가격이라 매장 가격과 조금 다를 수 있어요.
